source_commits.author: Ghosuto
source_commits.message:
power: Guard optional Pixel scheduler task profiles

Lineage devices without Pixel vendor_sched support can still use CPU
ADPF through sched_setattr, but every session currently tries to apply
SCHED_QOS profiles that are not defined on those devices.

Signed-off-by: Ghosuto <clash.raja10@gmail.com>
(cherry picked from commit 2c2cd5d6400da9d8718191efe3feb618cd47feae)

source_commits.author: Ghosuto
source_commits.message:
power: Drop delayed FMQ reports after pause or close

The framework sends session lifecycle calls over Binder while apps can
report work through FMQ. A queued frame can therefore be consumed after
pause or close, producing an error for an expected asynchronous race.

Signed-off-by: Ghosuto <clash.raja10@gmail.com>
(cherry picked from commit 71e207bf2a5cfd7e0f54a6e442d7d2e1b247d74d)

source_commits.author: Ghosuto
source_commits.message:
power: Discover optional task profiles from vendor-accessible config

isProfileValidForProcess is hidden behind __ANDROID_VNDK__, so vendor
Power HAL builds cannot use it. Cache profile names from the same system,
launch-API and vendor configuration files that libprocessgroup loads,
including aggregate profiles, and use the public task-profile setter.
Preserve profile application if inspection is incomplete so configuration
or permission errors remain visible instead of disabling device features.

Signed-off-by: Ghosuto <clash.raja10@gmail.com>
(cherry picked from commit b90fd8b4bec19d0cc3a0d6105cf838d72694342e)

source_commits.author: Ghosuto
source_commits.message:
libperfmgr: Synchronize ADPF profiles and callback registrations

ADPF event delivery can iterate callback storage while another thread
registers or unregisters a session. The original implementation permits
iterator invalidation and access to a callback object that has been freed.

Guard the profile maps, legacy profile index, and callback registry.
Deliver snapshots of owned callback registrations without holding the
registry mutex, and mark removed registrations inactive. Callers must
still protect the lifetime of objects captured by their callbacks.

Keep the two-argument registration behavior and add an overload that
notifies a new subscriber of the current profile. Serialize that initial
notification with event delivery so a session registered after construction
cannot miss a profile change.

The original callback registry reproduced an AddressSanitizer
heap-use-after-free during concurrent registration and delivery. Host
checks using the actual header, parser, callback methods, and Lineage HAL
callback implementation pass ASan, UBSan, and TSan. A full Android build
and post-flash validation remain necessary.

Signed-off-by: Ghosuto <clash.raja10@gmail.com>
